notes: Opening the app does one full check with the server, so a missed update (like a teammate finishing a stop) always comes through.
The header logo shows just the icon, with no dark box behind it, in light and dark mode.
Coming back to the app, tapping a notification, or opening Notifications now pulls the newest copy, so Casey's Completed shows right away and closes your stop.
Auto Spread fills the earliest open weekdays first, even when a day already has a stop across town, and only uses a later day when earlier ones are full.
On Winterization, Spread, Optimize and Settings sit in an even row right under the filters.
Route stop buttons grow to fit their words at large text, so Mark Winterization Complete stays inside the button.
Tapping the Customers search, or any other box, no longer zooms the iPhone screen. Pinch zoom still works.
Stops you send to Casey no longer show as Missed. They read Sent To Casey · Accepted or Pending, and close on your side when he completes them.
Schedule Into shows the full date with large text. The date and Window boxes stack when there is no room side by side.
No more brief freezes every minute or so while your book backs up in the background, so taps stay quick.
A new company does not start on Twin Falls. City send stays off until you pick or request your city. Preview builds say Test Mode and do not use a real city inbox.
